description: This header file declares utility functions for network management operations, including querying device properties, interface statuses, security modes, and managing persistent configuration files within the 'WPEFramework::Plugin' namespace.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for network device properties, interface status, security modes, and configuration file management.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Fetches properties of network devices, implementation not provided in header.

methods.name: deviceHostname
methods.description: Retrieves the device hostname from persistent storage.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to signal strength metrics.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison between two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode from access point flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Extracts Wi-Fi frequency from access point data.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Generates a string description of security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager logging level to trace for debugging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes marker files for interface control.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether a given network interface is enabled.

methods.name: writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes the hostname to persistent storage.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the hostname from persistent storage.
